name: Jigoku-koushi
source:
The Haughty Costumed Girl

A girl who dresses particularly strangely, even by the standards of Hell. Not much is known about her, but she's a certified weirdo. Reckless, Feckless, Careless.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446494112801021]Steiner[/url]]
